name: - EulerFinance
fix_description: In donateToReserves, the function allows users to donate their eToken balance to reserves without checking if the account remains healthy (collateral > debt) after the donation. Attacker deposits, borrows, then donates most collateral to reserves making themselves under-collateralized, then self-liquidates at a discount. Fix: add a liquidity check after the donation to ensure the account is not left in violation.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step protocol-specific attack involving flash-loaned capital, recursive Euler mint/repay flows, reserve donation to manipulate account health, and then liquidation via a separate contract. While the PoC is short, understanding why the sequence works requires meaningful knowledge of Euler’s collateral/debt accounting and liquidation mechanics, so it is more than a straightforward pattern.
